status: Pure closed contracts and unavailable default port only; no durable provider, worker adapter, persistence migration or production acceptance

JobItemCommand.binding: Deterministic from original ReferenceJobCommand and exact member item plus trusted pinned destination. itemOperationId=original item.resultId. Hash full job and closed original item; no fresh timestamp/IDs on replay.

JobItemReceipt.binding: Configured namespace/generation/key proof; exact command tuple/actor/correlation and request fingerprint. Closed coherent JobItemOutcome. Original server-derived earliest commit <= committedAt <= current trusted observation; receipt fingerprint excludes its own proof.

JobItemLookupQuery.binding: Exact original command/destination/item/job tuple plus fresh server nonce and canonical issuedAt. Full query fingerprint binds caller observation context.

states.committed: Signed exact query/nonce/full-ledger statement with original signed receipt; nested receipt must reverify and commit no later than checkedAt.
states.not-committed: Signed exact query/nonce/full-ledger statement with null receipt. Point-in-time absence only; never future absence or business permission.

contracts.VerifiedJobItemReceipt: Private construction; outcomeFor rechecks current caller command, trust policy and time bounds; no public positive status/body shortcut. Historical receipt never current authorization.
contracts.VerifiedJobItemLookup: Private construction and private status/payload; resolveFor rechecks exact original command+query fingerprints, current trust, nonce and times on every consumption, including cached caps.

JobExecutionAuthority.default: UnavailableJobExecutionAuthority: execute throws JobHandlerUnavailable; lookup returns unknown.

proof_rules: Reuse bounded16KiB canonical JSON; exact schemaVersion1, lowercase UUIDv4,64hex fingerprints/nonces, canonical UTC millisecond times and closed scalar/nested shapes.
Top-level proof excluded from its own signature; signed lookup includes full nested original receipt/proof. No algorithm/key selection from untrusted payload.
Caller supplies trusted original job/command commit lower bound and current observation upper bound; reject invalid windows and implicit clock skew.
Single pinned generation scope; rotation/revocation mismatch stays fenced, never silently rebuild/retarget the original command.
Unknown/no receipt may not be converted into definitive failure/success. False/incomplete/unsigned local absence is not noncommit.

Per-consumption lookup requires caller-owned active query and earliest acceptable challenge time: originalLower <= issuedAt <= checkedAt <= callerObservedAt; earliestLookup <= issuedAt. Receipt originalLower <= committedAt <= checkedAt.

A historical receipt and later lookup can have different signed checkpoint references; never infer ownership/currentness from reference strings. Reverify nested receipt key even if outer lookup key remains trusted.
future_provider_requirements: Atomic per-original-item idempotency binds immutable command fingerprint and definitive result/receipt; a changed body under same item key must conflict.
Authenticated challenged complete history with durable retention, independent recovery/key ownership, prompt trust revocation and accepted cross-generation recovery.
Persist or recover the original item command/receipt, never regenerate dynamic values under the old key; handler I/O remains outside producer/outbox transactions.

Future reconciler: verify lookup; committed=>verify original receipt and current gates; unknown=>fence; authenticated noncommit=>only original idempotent execute after separate current authorization/recovery, then verify returned receipt.
No exactly-once claim for a remote non-idempotent effect. Item-key receipt uniqueness, custody and shared worker/outage/restore acceptance need a real durable provider.
non_goals: No Mongo schema or accepted catalogue change.
No generic worker/ReferenceJobHandler behavior change or positive runtime handler binding.
No institutional policy, key owner, legal basis, production budget/region or approval selected.
rollback: Selective source/handoff rollback after review; preserve all prior uncommitted code, receipts/original commands/audit evidence and protected archive. No data drop/cleanup.
